criteria.criterion: Establish and record whether `rebar create` currently consults the overlap detector, with the file and line that does or does not.

A ticket whose title matches an existing ticket's is SURFACED at creation time — the author is told, with the candidate ticket's id and status. Proven by creating a same-title ticket in a test and asserting the signal appears. Title match is the minimum bar (normalized: case, punctuation, whitespace folded), bounded to the 600 s recency window per the measured design.

The signal does not block creation. Legitimate same-title tickets exist (follow-ups, retries, per-environment variants); the requirement is that the author is INFORMED, not prevented — exit code 0, ticket created, warning on stderr/logger/result-field only.
